verdict.rationale: Autumn has no general-purpose scheduler for recurring jobs. Its only time-based automation is in the billing domain: the createSchedule endpoint sets up multi-phase subscriptions whose phases switch over automatically at their scheduled start times. Webhooks on plan changes can trigger external workflows, but the scheduling itself would have to live in another tool. Missing for 10: a general recurring job or cron scheduling capability, user-defined scheduled workflows, any agent- or MCP-driven scheduling, and independent corroboration.
